description: This source file defines the ManageAccountAdapter class, a RecyclerView adapter for displaying account items in an Android application. It manages a list of Account objects, handles view holder creation and binding, and interacts with callback interfaces to facilitate user interactions.

classes.name: ManageAccountAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter for managing and displaying a list of Account objects in the UI, with support for item selection and updating the list.

methods.name: ManageAccountAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with a callback and enabling stable IDs.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID for the account at the given position.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the item view layout and creates a new ViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds account data to the ViewHolder at a specific position.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of accounts in the list.

methods.name: setLocalAccounts
methods.description: Updates the internal list of accounts and refreshes the display.

methods.name: setCurrentLocalAccount
methods.description: Sets the currently selected local account and refreshes the display.
